findings.message: Codex review of TASK-039 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Performance benchmark implementation is complete with appropriate thresholds and gate strictness.
Golden-scene performance benchmark harness provides deterministic measurement of cold start, interaction latency, and FPS. This enables reproducible performance validation across runs.

Tier-aware configuration in data/performance/golden_scenes.json defines explicit thresholds for tier1 and tier2 hardware, enabling differentiated performance validation based on target hardware capabilities.
Performance CI gate script properly integrated into run-quality-gates.sh, ensuring performance validation is part of the standard quality gate pipeline.
Environment variable export propagation to Godot process is fixed, resolving potential issues with test execution environment setup.
Deployment configuration (deployment_config.gd) and feature flag service (feature_flag_service.gd) provide robust rollout control mechanisms, protecting production deployments.
Feature flag test coverage in test_feature_flag_service.gd validates service behavior. Application suite in run_application_tests.gd includes deployment profile and rollout controls validation.

All validation passes successfully: run-performance-gates.sh (exit 0), run-application-suite.sh (exit 0), run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0). Performance thresholds confirmed suitable for release expectations.
Review request documentation confirms threshold suitability and gate strictness are appropriate for release expectations.

summary: APPROVE. TASK-039 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Performance benchmarks with tier-aware configuration and CI integration are fully operational. All acceptance criteria are met: golden scenes benchmark cold start/interaction latency/FPS, tier-aware config with explicit thresholds. Thresholds and gate strictness are suitable for release. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
